description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the full workflow and all referenced files. 2. Agent reads references/score-band-table.md to convert raw score 34/40 → Band 7.5 (NOT a range — score 34 has 'Boundary? No' per the table, unlike score 29 which IS a boundary). 3. Agent computes total time: 28:15+31:44+38:03 = 98:02 and formats it as per-passage breakdown. 4. Agent reads references/538-keywords-guide.md to rate vocabulary: 'innovative' is in Category 1 (top 54, ⭐⭐⭐), 'domain' is Category 3 (⭐), 'intrinsic'/'conducive' are not in the 538 list (—). 5. Agent reads references/error-taxonomy.md to classify Q28 and Q31 as [D-NGvsFALSE], Q32 as [C-Inference] or [B-Scope]. 6. Agent reads sessions/progress_history.json to pull all 5 prior test results and constructs a 6-row cumulative progress table. 7. Agent generates HTML using assets/review-template.html as structural/CSS foundation with all 6 sections in mandatory order (📌→❌→🔄→📝→💡→📊). 8. Agent names the file following the convention: 剑17-T2-P3-<topic>复盘.html. 9. Synonym table uses correct column order: 原文表达→题目表达→中文释义→题号. 10. Includes progress analysis (trend, speed vs 60-min limit, strategy advice). 11. Includes feedback nudge with GitHub link.
